cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:34a.title: Store Floor Lead, FT (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:34a.team: 076 - Mercato - Sur La Table, 9105 Strada Place, Naples, FL 34108
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:34a.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Store Floor Lead, FT at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this leadership role, the StoreFloor Lead, FT supports the General Manager (GM) or Store Manager (SM) in achieving sales and operational goals. As a key driver of in-store performance, Store Floor Lead, FT serves as the Manager on Duty (MOD), ensuring smooth daily operations and always delivering a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Lead the sales floor and oversee daily store operations as Manager on Duty (MOD). · Provides in-the-moment coaching and feedback to elevate performance and team engagement. Communicate performance issues directly to the General Manager/Store Manager. · Support onboarding, training, and development of new associates. Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture. · Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely manner to maintain satisfaction and loyalty. Sales & Business Performance · Support the achievement of store sales goals through effective customer engagement and team motivation. · Maximize selling opportunities by identifying customer needs and offering relevant solutions. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Operations & Compliance · Direct employees to ensure appropriate merchandise stock levels and that the selling floor is adequately stocked and merchandised in accordance with visual standards. · Complete inventory transactions including, but not limited to, receiving, MOS (Mark Out of Stock), and RARs (Return Authorization Requests). · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time. · Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise. · Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work. · Workweeks are expected to be between 32 and 36 hours with the ability to have a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. · Regular and predictable attendance. Qualifications & Experience · Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employmen

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:38b.description: Welcome to the Table. At Sur La Table, community, culinary joy, and celebration are at the heart of who we are. From monthly spotlights to the Golden Whisk awards and cooking class perks, our culture blends recognition with hands-on experiences. New team members are welcomed with care and inspired by wellness events, inclusive stories, and a personal touch that makes you feel right at home. Reports to: VP of Strategy & AI Transformation Location: Seattle, WA or San Francisco, CA (Hybrid - 1-2 days/week in office)
responsibilities: Partner with the Head of Strategy, President, CFO, and Leadership Team to develop the Long-Range Plan and Annual Operating Plan, ensuring Tech and AI Roadmaps align to strategy, and track in-year progress against core initiatives and KPIs

Support the development of a multi-year Real Estate strategy grounded in analytical rigor, customer insights, and brand positioning—track the pipeline and lease renewals, partner with Finance on new lease proformas, review lease terms, and lead communications with construction and store operations teams

Build business cases, analyze company, customer, and external data, assess consumer insights and competitive benchmarks, and create key decision dashboards to support critical business decisions
Identify key consumer, competitive, vendor, and market trends and translate insights into actionable go-to-market implications and recommendations

Enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of the President and Leadership Team through ad hoc support—board decks, partnership presentations, townhall materials, survey analysis, and project management
qualifications: 2+ years in a strategy consulting role with a focus on revenue growth and/or private equity diligence
Retail experience with a brand- and consumer-first mindset
Strong project management skills with experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams
Analytical rigor and financial modeling expertise; advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
Heavy user of AI tools to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
Strong communication skills, executive presence, and ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders across levels
Intellectual curiosity that drives an innovative, problem-solving mindset

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:cd7afa1c-fd9.title: Customer Support Representative
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:cd7afa1c-fd9.description: Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses. We help companies get high-quality support across roles like executive assistance, admin support, customer support, sales support, recruiting support, operations support, and other business functions. The Role You're the first person our customers hear from when they need help. They message us by email, chat, or phone, and you make sure they get a fast, helpful answer. Most questions you'll answer yourself. For the ones that need a specialist or a manager, you pass them along with the full story so nothing gets repeated and nothing falls through the cracks. Either way, the customer walks away feeling taken care of.This role is about speed and care. You're not handling pricing or sales, you're the friendly, reliable first response that keeps customers happy.
responsibilities: What you'll do
Answer customer messages by email, chat, and phone, quickly and kindly
Solve common questions yourself: billing, account status, how things work, document requests
For bigger issues, pass them to the right team with clear notes so the customer never has to repeat themselves
Handle urgent problems fast: know who to alert and keep the customer updated until it's fixed
Always tell the customer what happens next and when
Keep clear notes on every conversation
qualifications: Excellent written English, clear, warm, and fast (most of this job is writing to customers)
2+ years in customer support, customer service, virtual assistance, or BPO
Comfortable working US hours, including some evenings and weekends
Calm and clear when things get busy or stressful
Organized, you can juggle many conversations without dropping any
Comfortable learning new support and chat tools
Reliable home internet, a quiet workspace, and a backup internet plan

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b6f33db0-f828-.title: GL Accountant
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b6f33db0-f828-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a GL Accountant based in the United States. This fully remote role supports the financial operations of multiple small-business clients through accurate and timely accounting. You’ll manage core general ledger activities while contributing to accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, reconciliations, and tax-related processes. The position offers exposure to a diverse portfolio of businesses, requiring strong organization and the ability to manage competing priorities. You’ll work independently while collaborating with experienced accounting and finance professionals who support your development. Your attention to detail and sound accounting judgment will help clients maintain reliable financial records and make informed decisions. The role is well suited to an accounting professional who enjoys variety, problem-solving, and improving processes. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a remote, service-oriented accounting environment. Record financial transactions accurately and consistently across multiple client accounting systems. Post customer payments and maintain current accounts receivable aging reports as needed. Process vendor invoices, apply appropriate accounting judgment when coding expenses, obtain payment authorization, and schedule payments through automated systems. Reconcile bank activity with general ledger accounts and investigate discrepancies. Process online payroll and ensure related transactions are recorded in the appropriate accounts. Prepare and file sales and property tax obligations when required by individual clients. Complete additional accounting activities based on the specific needs of assigned clients. Accurately track time spent across multiple client engagements to support budgeting, resource planning, and billing. Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and contribute practical solutions to recurring challenges. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 3+ years of accounting and/or full-charge bookkeeping experience. Working knowledge of accrual-basis accounting and payroll requirements. Experience with QuickBooks Online and other cloud-based accounting or automation platforms. Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and common productivity tools. Strong communication, organization, and time-management skills. Ability to manage multiple client engagements, prioritize effectively, and shift between competing deadlines. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the initiative to identify and recommend process improvements. Ability to work independently and remain accountable in a fully remote environment. Curious, enthusiastic mindset with a willingness to learn across a broad range of accounting and small-business topics. Creative and improvement-oriented approach, with confidence suggesting better ways of working. Must be located in the Eastern or Central U.S. time zones. Benefits: Salary: $70,000–$75,000 per year. Medical, dental, vision, and FSA/HSA benefits. Employee coverage is fully paid, with dependents covered on most plans. 15 days of vacation time. Paid time off for 12 holidays, plus 5 sick days and one floating holiday of your choice. Ongoing guidance, support, and knowledge-sharing from experienced accounting, finance, and small-business professionals. Fully remote work environment with the opportunity to support a diverse range of client businesses. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ec404260-0ff6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding Engineer (Potential CTO) based in Canada. This is a high-impact founding engineering opportunity at an early-stage healthtech startup developing an AI-powered nervous system rehabilitation platform. You will be the second technical leader, taking ownership of the product and technology stack from mobile experience to AI infrastructure and real-time biosignal processing. The role offers significant influence over architecture, product direction, engineering practices, and the future technical organization. You will build an AI coaching experience that combines frontier AI models with personalized physiological data and wearable technologies. Working closely with the founding team, you will turn ambitious concepts into reliable products used by real customers. The position is ideal for a hands-on engineer who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and is comfortable making foundational technical decisions. There is a clear path toward a CTO role for someone who demonstrates strong technical leadership and a compelling founder mindset. Own technical direction, architecture, and execution as the founding engineer, with the potential to grow into the CTO role. Build and launch the first end-to-end AI coaching experience, spanning the React Native mobile application through AI model inference. Architect and develop an AI-powered nervous system training coach, including model integration, prompt engineering, tool use, and evaluation frameworks. Translate real-time biosignals such as HRV, breathing, motion, and PPG into personalized coaching experiences for users. Develop AI-powered quality assurance and testing pipelines that enable safe, reliable, and high-frequency product releases. Make full-stack technical decisions across mobile frontend, backend services, infrastructure, databases, AI-native systems, and integrations. Build and maintain integrations with iOS HealthKit and wearable platforms such as Apple Watch, Oura, Whoop, and EEG headbands. Own the complete mobile product lifecycle, including development, release management, debugging, monitoring, iteration, and ongoing optimization. Work closely with the founding team to translate product vision into scalable technical solutions and prioritize high-impact initiatives. Establish engineering practices, technical standards, and development processes that can support the growth of the future engineering organization. Make pragmatic architectural and product trade-offs in a fast-moving environment while maintaining quality, reliability, and user safety. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in mobile and full-stack software engineering, with a demonstrated ability to take consumer mobile products from 0→1 and ship them to real users. Deep proficiency with React Native and experience owning the complete mobile development lifecycle. Production experience with Claude or other frontier AI models , including prompt engineering, tool use, model integration, and evaluation. Strong understanding of AI-native application architecture, with experience integrating AI throughout the product and technology stack rather than treating it as an isolated feature. Backend development experience using Node.js or Python , ideally with PostgreSQL and modern cloud infrastructure such as Vercel, Fly, or Render. Hands-on experience with Apple HealthKit, wearable APIs, or real-time biosignal data , including HRV, PPG, motion, or related physiological signals. Strong architectural and systems-design capabilities, with the ability to make independent technical decisions in an early-stage environment. Founder mindset, entrepreneurial approach, and ideally previous experience as a first engineer or early-stage startup team member. Ability to operate effectively with significant autonomy, ambiguity, changing priorities, and limited resources. Strong communication and collabo

southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.title: M&P Lab Technician
southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.description: Boom is building supersonic jet engines, which means we work with high-temperature superalloys all day, every day - parts in fabrication, parts on the drawing board, and parts coming back from our on-site test cell with a story to tell. Reading that story is lab work: sectioning, polishing, etching, testing, measuring, and documenting. You’ll be Boom’s first M&P lab tech—meaning you play a foundational role in setting up the lab and setting the standards for world-class labwork. This is your opportunity to do it right, the way you’ve always wanted to.This role is the person who does it. Upstart R&D environment—not rote production QC Most met lab jobs exist inside an established system - procedures released, equipment qualified, the same tests running on the same parts every shift. You show up and execute the standard, over and over again. This is a very different job. Boom's materials lab - metallography, mechanical testing, SEM - is being built right now, in parallel with the engine program it supports. The prep routes, the calibration system, the report templates, the sample tracking: the first versions of those will have your name on them, built side by side with the lab's engineers. And at Boom the technician/engineer line deliberately blurs - you'll help plan test campaigns and shape the lab, not just execute work orders. Is this indication a defect or a prep artifact? Did this heat treat do what the spec says it did? Why does this blade look like that after 50 hours in the test cell? What you'll do Prepare metallurgical samples - sectioning, mounting, polishing, etching - across stainless steels, titanium, and nickel-based superalloys Perform microstructural analysis on engine components: machined, brazed, welded, heat-treated, and thermally sprayed hardware Run hardness and microhardness testing, furnace uniformity surveys, and chemical/cleaning solution analysis Support mechanical test operations - tensile, fatigue, creep, elevated temperature - alongside the lab engineer: specimen handling, setup, and data recording Support failure and damage investigations on hardware from Boom's engine test cell, alongside M&P engineers Evaluate supplier material and process certifications against engineering specs and drawings Write the reports: traceable, complete, and defensible - your documentation is the permanent engineering record Help stand up the lab itself: procedures, calibration systems, equipment selection input, consumables management Support allowables and material characterization test programs as they spin up This job is demanding The procedure you need won't always exist yet - you'll write it, with the help of some of the best materials scientists and engineers in the world. The part on your bench may be the only one of its kind, and the data you help generate will drive material decisions on an engine program. That requires craft-level prep skill, real interpretive judgment at the microscope, and documentation discipline that survives scrutiny years later. And you’ll get to see your work manifested rapidly in the engines we build, test, and ship—and which eventually carry passengers faster than the speed of sound. You probably have 2+ years hands-on experience in a metallurgical or materials testing laboratory Strong metallographic prep skills and microstructure evaluation experience - ideally on aerospace alloys (nickel superalloys, titanium, stainless) Hardness and microhardness testing proficiency Experience reading engineering drawings, AMS/ASTM specs, and supplier certifications Disciplined documentation habits from an AS9100/NADCAP-type environment The ability to work independently and communicate findings directly to engineers It would be great if you have Mechanical testing experience: tensile, fatigue (LCF/HCF), creep, or elevated-temperature testing Failure analysis experience: fractography, SEM/EDS exposure, root cause investigation support Furnace survey / pyrometry (AMS 2750) experience Experience sta
